lessons.title: Unit 0: Learn How to Read Hangul
lessons.explanation: Learn the Korean alphabet, syllable blocks, consonants, vowels and the combinations needed to read Korean words.
lessons.meaning: HTSK Unit 0 teaches basic Korean consonants and vowels, syllable blocks, final consonants, additional letters and combined vowels. It also recommends moving away from romanization and using Korean audio and reading practice.
lessons.when_to_use: Study this foundation when you want to strengthen reading, pronunciation or syllable-block recognition.
lessons.how_to_build: Arrange consonants and vowels into one-syllable blocks. The vowel occupies the second position; a final consonant can be added below. Lessons 2 and 3 continue with more letters and complex vowels.
examples: ㄱ + ㅏ → 가
A consonant and vowel form one syllable block.
ㅂ + ㅏ + ㅂ → 밥
A syllable can include a final consonant.
ㅗ + ㅏ → ㅘ
Two vowels can combine into a complex vowel.
